Index.title: Modern Construction ERP
Index.description: Welcome to the Modern Construction ERP

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.description: Manage construction projects and their lifecycle.

Contracts.title: Prime Contracts
Contracts.description: Commercial contract administration, change management, and retention baselines.

WBS.title: Work Breakdown Structure
WBS.description: Hierarchical project deliverables and work packages.

CostCodes.title: Standard Cost Codes
CostCodes.description: CSI MasterFormat uniform cost accounting codes.

BOQ.title: Bill of Quantities
BOQ.description: Itemized construction scope and measured quantities.

Estimates.title: Cost Estimating
Estimates.description: Direct cost build-ups and markup estimations.

Budgets.title: Project Budgets
Budgets.description: Approved project budget baselines and cost code control.

Subcontracts.title: Trade Subcontracts
Subcontracts.description: Subcontract packages, specialized trade contractors, and retention commitments.

ChangeOrders.title: Variation Orders (VO)
ChangeOrders.description: Contractual variations, client change orders (CCO), and subcontract adjustments (SCO).

PaymentApplications.title: Progress Billings & Claims
PaymentApplications.description: Client interim payment certificates (IPC), subcontractor payment claims, and GL postings.

Suppliers.title: Suppliers & Vendors Directory
Suppliers.description: Vendor directory, TRN tax identifiers, contacts, and qualification status.

Requisitions.title: Purchase Requisitions
Requisitions.description: Site material demands, cost code validation, and multi-tier approval workflow.

RFQs.title: Requests for Quotation
RFQs.description: Vendor tender publishing, competitive bid solicitation, and quotation evaluation.

PurchaseOrders.title: Purchase Orders
PurchaseOrders.description: Procurement commitments, supplier order issuance, and delivery schedule control.

Materials.title: Materials Master Catalog
Materials.description: Standardized item catalog, technical specifications, units of measure, and active inventory valuations.

Warehouses.title: Storage Yards & Site Warehouses
Warehouses.description: Central logistics bases, on-site staging yards, laydown areas, and inter-site transit buffers.

GoodsReceipts.title: Goods Receipt Notes (GRN)
GoodsReceipts.description: Material delivery intake inspection, purchase order matching, warehouse laydown intake, and WAC stock ledger posting.

MaterialIssues.title: Material Issues to Project Sites
MaterialIssues.description: Store requisition slips, site material dispatches, work package allocation, and project cost code charging.

APInvoices.title: Accounts Payable & Invoicing
APInvoices.description: Contractor 3-way matching, variance detection, GL posting, and vendor liability management.

APPayments.title: Vendor Payments & Disbursements
APPayments.description: Treasury cash disbursement vouchers, general ledger settlement, and AP invoice allocation.

ChartOfAccounts.title: Chart of Accounts (COA)
ChartOfAccounts.description: Enterprise construction general ledger chart of accounts with real-time balance aggregation.

JournalVouchers.title: Journal Vouchers & GL Studio
JournalVouchers.description: Double-entry journal vouchers with real-time debit/credit balancing, project cost allocation, and audit reversal.

FinancialPeriods.title: Financial Periods & Closing
FinancialPeriods.description: Fiscal year accounting period lifecycle, month-end lock controls, and audit integrity.

FinancialStatements.title: Financial Statements & Reporting
FinancialStatements.description: Real-time Trial Balance, Balance Sheet, and Income Statement (P&L) generated directly from posted journal lines.

ARInvoices.title: Client Invoices & Progress Billing
ARInvoices.description: AIA G702/G703 style progress billing applications, retainage withholding, and double-entry GL postings.

CustomerCollections.title: Customer Collections & Receipts
CustomerCollections.description: Treasury cash receipt vouchers, general ledger settlement, and open invoice allocation.

CostControl.title: Project Cost Control & EVM
CostControl.description: Real-time synchronization of budgets, committed subcontracts/POs, actual incurred costs, and Estimate-to-Complete (ETC).
